'''Squad Eight''' was a division of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. The [[Imperial soldier]]s of Squad Eight were wiped out during the [[Invasion of Begeren]].
